answer: Filling 154 aliases thus needs 154 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. Because the rationale is hashed into the copper record and indexed in the atlas history, the delta audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 5 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
